correctness.rationale: The exact covariance matrix and characteristic polynomial follow from independence and conditional squares. At positive momentum the characteristic polynomial is negative at either beta or the best SGD rate, giving a real eigenvalue above the optimum. Zero-momentum optimum is an exact strictly convex quadratic. Discrete Lyapunov and positive resolvent establish the exact if-and-only-if stability condition including boundary. Standalone exact rational checker passed 1152 path-sum, 120 polynomial, and 48 stability cases.

value.rationale: The 2026 theory motivates asking when minibatch curvature variance alone permits strict heavy-ball acceleration. This result isolates a natural entire stochastic interpolation class, proves a unique globally optimized rate, and quantifies a sharp high-momentum batch-size stability cost. It distinguishes spectral heterogeneity from stochastic curvature noise and is neither a single exceptional point nor a trivial bound.
